## Get data 

### Gender pay 

```{r, eval = F}
# https://gender-pay-gap.service.gov.uk/viewing/download
years <- 2017:2025
for(i in years){
  download.file(paste0('https://gender-pay-gap.service.gov.uk/viewing/download-data/', i), paste0('posts/data/gender_pay_data_', i, '.csv'))
}
```
